title: Field.OS AEGIS
description: AEGIS: Adaptive Environmental Guidance & Information System. Choose what the HUD shows and when. Changes apply within a few seconds.

settings.label: Ready-made setup
optionLabels: Explorer - compass on top, environment and supplies, no ammo
Combat - health, ammo and supplies always, simple compass
Immersive - no compass, only what needs attention
settings.hint: Anything except Custom overrides the individual switches below.

settings.label: Health
optionLabels: Only when needed (combat, injured, just healed)
settings.hint: The quiet readout keeps a light look; a solid plate appears only when it needs your attention.

settings.label: Oxygen / CO2
optionLabels: Only when needed (low oxygen, CO2, combat)
settings.hint: Shows the breathing readout of your suit.

settings.label: Ammo
settings.hint: Magazine and reserve. Hidden while aiming down sights.

settings.label: Ammo while aiming
settings.hint: Keeps the ammo readout visible when you aim down sights or look through a scope.

settings.label: Compass
settings.hint: Tape: scrolling heading tape with quest and enemy markers. Simple: heading, one pointer to the nearest objective and enemy side pointers. Try Simple if you notice flicker while turning.

settings.label: Compass position
settings.hint: Moves the compass, its quest marker and its distance to the top centre of the screen.

settings.label: Status chips
settings.hint: Short chips above the compass: afflictions (by body system), radiation and other hazards, hunger and thirst, environmental damage, overload, boostpack, healing, medpack used, health boost.

settings.label: Supplies line
settings.hint: Carry weight, medpacks (counted from Favorites) and grenades under the instruments.

settings.label: Level and XP line
settings.hint: A small line under the supplies row: character level and progress to the next level. Follows the supplies line.

settings.label: Starborn power charge
settings.hint: A short chip with the charge of your Starborn power while it recharges. Nothing is shown when the power is full or unused.

settings.label: Environment panel (bottom left)
settings.hint: System, planet, place, temperature, gravity and air quality.

settings.label: Active effects panel (bottom left)
settings.hint: Hazards, afflictions and survival-mod effects with their names and warnings.

settings.label: Scan report (scanner only)
settings.hint: While the scanner is open: cards with location, conditions, time and funds, suit and vitals, and your profile.

settings.label: Time and credits line
settings.hint: A small line under the quest tracker with the local time and your credits.

settings.label: AEGIS notices
settings.hint: Short informational notices on the right: the game's own alerts (hazards, afflictions) and warnings such as low health, low ammo, extreme cold or heat, low oxygen, suit protection running out, overload, hunger and thirst.

settings.label: Game alerts and condition icons
settings.hint: The game's own condition icons and alert banners (hazards, afflictions, hunger) at the bottom left, drawn by the game itself. The old watch, oxygen ring and readouts stay hidden.

settings.label: Quest tracker (top right)
settings.hint: The active quest, its current objective and the distance to the nearest target.

settings.label: Calm third person
settings.hint: In third person with the weapon holstered only the compass, the quest tracker and important notices stay (critical health, low air, status chips, active effects).

settings.label: Only with the suit on
settings.hint: Shows the HUD only while your suit is powered and booted (the HUD framework's suitHasBooted state), so it appears with the helmet on. Off by default: if the HUD stays hidden with the suit on, switch this off.

settings.label: Show in third person
settings.hint: Off hides the whole HUD while the third-person camera is used.

settings.label: Rows
settings.hint: How many effects the panel lists at most.

settings.label: List
settings.hint: All also lists food, drink and other beneficial effects.

settings.label: Short plate flashes
settings.hint: A brief solid plate when a weapon is drawn, changed or reloaded and after a burst of damage. Off keeps only the persistent warnings.
